instruction: Please launch Visual Studio Code and load the project directory from /home/user/project.

command: cd /home/user/Downloads && unzip -q vscodeEvalExtension.zip && code --install-extension vscodeEvalExtension/eval-0.0.1.vsix && rm -rf vscodeEvalExtension vscodeEvalExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Task requires loading the project folder in VS Code. Reuses existing compare_config metric to verify 'project' folder is opened. This is a paraphrase variation with same evaluator logic but different instruction wording.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator uses established VS Code extension pattern to verify folder is opened
Postconfig properly activates VS Code window before verification

Expected value 'project' matches the folder name from instruction '/home/user/project'
